introHtml: Recycled PET badge ID holders offer a sustainable alternative to standard PVC holders without sacrificing clarity or durability. Made from post-consumer plastic bottles, these holders are ideal for companies prioritizing eco-friendly swag. They work perfectly for trade shows, employee IDs, or visitor badges and can be customized with your logo using screen printing or debossing. Choose recycled PET to align your promotional products with your green initiatives.
